title: The Cedar Room

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Located in the historic Cigar Factory, The Cedar Room offers a distinctive blend of Charleston charm and modern versatility. Just steps from the city’s business district and waterfront, our venue is perfectly situated for hosting corporate gatherings in a location that’s both accessible and memorable. From holiday parties and charity galas to product launches, team dinners, and networking receptions, The Cedar Room is designed to host a wide range of professional events. With a spacious interior, private courtyard, full-service catering, and dedicated on-site support, our team is here to bring your event to life with ease and intention.
